verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a searchable query stats table where you can drill down to a single execution with its time breakdown and see grouped error signatures. It also exposes the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable across the whole cluster at once. Together these cover the core need of diagnosing slow or expensive queries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of execution-plan inspection (EXPLAIN is only implied by the 'every query works unchanged' compatibility claim), detail on per-query resource/cost metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
